impeccable.reason: Detector false positive in lifekit's cmn-app-layout (accepted in lifekit-common's design baseline): the shell CSS-hides the nav it is not using, and a badge in that display:none subtree has no box, so its negative offsets read as escaping the clip.
A scan that lands before the feed answers sees the loading skeleton; its shimmer is a loading signal and stops under prefers-reduced-motion (accepted in lifekit-common's design baseline).
Detector false positive: the event rows' sublabel (cmn-list-item-row) is one truncated line, and line-height only spaces wrapped lines; the rule counts characters, not lines.
